concepts.meaning: An explicit bound action that evaluates declared guards, prepares validated data and awaits one state/outbox commit.
An implementation dependency whose provider owns isolation and atomic commit; the caller cannot prove storage durability from its acknowledgement.
One immutable collection of typed Entity write snapshots and distinct Event occurrences, prepared before commit.
A missing trustworthy terminal commit outcome; no rollback, success or safe retry is inferred.

distinctions: Entity snapshot is not arbitrary record meaning
factory validation is not field-shape normalization
prepared result is not committed result
generated caller correctness is not provider durability
